change: Disable OpenGL VSync on macOS; retain the existing fixed 60 Hz game loop and VSync behavior on other platforms. No temporary launcher is required.

cause_evidence.stack: Cocoa_GL_SwapWindow -> SDL_CondWait_REAL -> pthread_cond_wait on every sampled main-thread stack; no display-link thread in the archived failure
cause_evidence.current_before_run: A fresh selected-save launch succeeded before the patch, confirming the issue is intermittent rather than a guaranteed failure.
cause_evidence.source_behavior: Nonzero swap interval waits on display-link condition notifications without a timeout; zero skips that wait.

coverage: Normal Game.Run, no smoke mode or graphics overrides
Clean test exit and unchanged fixture save
verification.direct_entrypoint_verified: No-argument regular apphost launched from an empty working directory, reached the title and subsequently gameplay.
verification.live_input_incident: During a subsequent title-menu check, the live session had moved into gameplay. Down/Enter/Escape test inputs reached that session; automated input was stopped and the user was informed. No claim of isolated input verification is made from those captures.

limits: Only local macOS 26.7.1 arm64 was tested; other platforms retain their prior behavior.
This removes the blocked sync path from this game; it does not fix SDL or macOS display-link internals.
